feature: default-off grouped B2 sampler evaluation and bounded host profile snapshots
license: Apache-2.0; original mlx2 source refactor, no upstream code copied
modifications: Split native continuation sampling graph construction from evaluated response construction without changing the ordinary lane path.

MLX2_PAGED_GROUPED_SAMPLER=1 stages both lanes in original processor/sampler invocation order, evaluates the four existing graph outputs once, and constructs independent lane responses. Default remains separate per-lane eval. Route receipts expose grouped_sampler_eval and cumulative grouped_sampler_evals.

Add constant-size profile_counters_snapshot with host spans, read_count and existing physical dispatch counters. Staged graph receipts and physical proof checks use counters only. Research drivers copy cumulative detailed read work once after timed request completion. Full profile_snapshot remains an independent detail copy.
Do not change native arena, write/read terminal protocols, branch publication, public reader lifetime or cancellation ownership. Existing owning lifecycle suppresses the entire cohort on errors.

validation.results: 5 source-extracted standard-library fake contract tests passed
coverage: Processor context includes committed input; processor and sampler invocation order preserved across lanes
One eval with four outputs when enabled versus two evals with two outputs when disabled
Independent UID, output token, pending-token and per-lane RNG state
Stop and length terminal state, closed-lane refusal
Second sampler, eval, malformed shape and invalid token failures suppress cohort response and retain existing rollback behavior
Counters do not iterate detailed read history; full snapshots and host counters are independent copies
validation.device_guard: Standalone test imports no MLX runtime; explicit import finder rejects mlx and mlx.* before any Metal/device initialization. Actual MLX CPU tests were not run because imports can construct Metal resources.

shortest_native_gate: With fresh GPU ownership and both locks: paired B2 max_tokens=2 on the frozen model/artifact/environment, separate versus grouped sampling at identical lane seeds; compare exact token IDs/logprobs and per-lane RNG draws, require one grouped eval receipt and two independent responses, cancellation/error retirement with zero pending epochs/pages, then matched ordinary/v6/grouped complete-request performance runs with profiling counters only. Promotion requires parity and repeated request-level non-regression.
